title: MLEADERSTYLE pre-R2010 version refusal

scope.operation: Reject MLEADERSTYLE styleVersion values that cannot be represented by an AC1021 DXF target.
scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.87 lists group 179 only for R2010 and says its expected value is 2. AC1021 predates R2010 and has no group-179 representation.
scope.claim_boundary: Direct MLEADERSTYLE writer admission for the AC1021 version field only; no broader style, DXF, DWG or consumer support claim.

implementation: Refuse styleVersion values other than 2 before publication for every target version, including AC1021 where group 179 is omitted.
Preserve the caller's unsupported value and the existing destination on refusal; allow a same-adapter retry after restoring the representable default.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.refusal: Each invalid AC1021 value is refused in both encodings while preserving the destination sentinel and caller field.
evidence.retry: The same adapter retries with styleVersion 2; output succeeds and omits group 179 for AC1021.
evidence.matrix: Three nondefault values × two encodings, each with destination/caller preservation and corrected same-adapter retry. Existing RPP-5yu covers AC1024/AC1027 group-179 value-2 emission and refusal/retry.

remaining: Other MLEADERSTYLE version/source-presence fields, dependency profiles and native semantics remain open; P2 remains open.
